purpose: Separate shape/compiler pressure from checkpoint loading without changing production settings
stop_conditions: OOM or OOM_KILL counter becomes nonzero
compiler child identity cannot be captured
interpretation_rules: a JAX gather pass does not clear Torch bridge or full MLA attribution
a synthetic compile pass does not prove checkpoint serving success
cgroup current is not compiler RSS and summed RSS may double-count shared mappings
a pass with no native child identity is incomplete for exit137 attribution
safety: Do not submit until 8-chip capacity is explicitly revalidated; do not modify mmap policy, compiler concurrency, decode buckets, Flash path, 16-chip, or DCP.
